target.title: fix(discord): bound direct Discord gateway metadata response reads
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an unbounded response body read in the direct Discord gateway metadata path:
`extensions/discord/src/monitor/gateway-metadata.ts` called `response.text()` on the Discord `/gateway/bot` response without a byte cap.

A malicious or accidentally oversized payload could cause the process to run out of memory.

## Why This Change Was Made

Reuses the existing shared helper (`readDiscordGatewayMetadataBody`) to enforce the same 4 MB byte limit that is already used on the sibling guarded path (`fetchDiscordGatewayMetadataGuarded`). This makes the direct `fetchDiscordGatewayInfo` path equally bounded.

The GitHub releases `response.json()` bound was removed from this PR because it overlaps with the already-reviewed open PR #98844 (`fix(tools-manager): bound GitHub API release tag JSON response read`).

## User Impact

No user-visible behavior change under normal operation. OpenClaw is now protected from oversized Discord gateway metadata responses.

## Evidence

Local validation on `fix/response-bounding-tools-manager-discord`:

```bash
node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs \
  extensions/discord/src/monitor/gateway-metadata.ts

npx oxfmt --check --threads=1 \
  extensions/discord/src/monitor/gateway-metadata.ts

node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p extensions/discord/tsconfig.json --noEmit

node scripts/run-vitest.mjs \
  extensions/discord/src/monitor/gateway-metadata.test.ts
```

- Lint / format check: passed.
- Discord type-check: passed.
- Focused tests: passed.

CI on the latest push (`869c3bf914`) is fully green, including:
- `Real behavior proof` ✅
- `actionlint` ✅
- `Security High (actions)` ✅
- All changed-path test shards ✅

The `Real behavior proof` job covers the new loopback-server regression tests in `gateway-metadata.test.ts`:
- `fetchDiscordGatewayMetadataGuarded` rejects an oversized body.
- `fetchDiscordGatewayInfo` rejects an oversized body and surfaces the overflow detail in the fallback log.

Also addressed the ClawSweeper review note about the `DiscordGatewayFetch` contract: it now returns `Promise<Response>` instead of a minimal `ok/status/text` shape, so the bounded reader no longer relies on an unsafe cast.
